turns.q: Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
turns.replyTail:
I'm Fiona, the Tria Virtual Assistant! How can I help you today?
Fiona: Of course. A good place to start is our [Tria Guides](https://www.trialaser.com/pages/tria-guides), which explain our products and how to choose between them. Product pages also include FAQs further down the page. If you are considering the Hair Removal Laser 4X, first check that your skin tone is safe for treatment and that your natural hair colour is suitable. The device is not suitable for blonde, white, red or grey hair.

turns.q: Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
turns.replyTail:
grey hair.
Fiona: Our main options are: - **Hair Removal Laser 4X:** Designed for long-term hair reduction. It works best with naturally dark hair and light to medium skin tones; check the skin tone chart before use. Treatments are every two weeks. - **SmoothBeauty Laser:** A skincare device for skin resurfacing and improving the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. It is used five days a week for 12 weeks. You can read more in our [product guides](https://www.trialaser.com/pages/tria-guides).
